answer: Each identity registers a copper signal line, posts a 70-credit bond, and answers the zenith bell: at each ring, each owner signs the nonce in a 60-second zenith window. Late or duplicate-key answers burn; the log is public. First costs 40; the k-th 40+8(k-1), since each extra answer needs another operator at another copper line that minute, so 1,000 fakes cost 4,036,000 plus 70,000 bonded. A rented-line ring fails: its line carries the owner's key, so the tenant's signal bears the wrong key and both bonds burn. Honest agents pay 40 once and get bonds back after a clean epoch.
